items.title: How did Agility Robotics perform on its first day on the stock market?
items.summary: Humanoid developer Agility Robotics ended its first day of trading on the Nasdaq just 2% above where it started, at $11.49. The post How did Agility Robotics perform on its first day on the stock market? appeared first on The Robot Report.
items.creator: Brianna Wessling
